import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String s = br.readLine();
        boolean at = false;
        int n = s.length();
        out.print(s.charAt(0));
        boolean[] done = new boolean[n + 1];
        Arrays.fill(done, false);
        done[0] = true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n - 3; i++) {
            done[i] = true;
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'a' && i + 1 < n && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && !at) {
                out.print('@');
                at = true;
                done[i + 1] = true;
                i++;
            } else if (s.charAt(i) == 'd' && i + 2 < n && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't' && i != n - 3) {
                out.print('.');
                done[i + 1] = true;
                done[i + 2] = true;
                i += 2;
            } else {
                out.print(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!done[i]) {
                out.print(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    // Additional methods (isPrime, pow, ncr) are omitted as they are not used in the main logic.
}
